text:
At [Company], we're rebuilding how freight moves, and that work runs on data. We're a Series A logistics startup with 60 people and $12M raised, working to get goods where they need to go faster and more reliably. Every shipment, route, and delivery window produces data, and we need a Data Engineer to turn that steady stream into something our operators, analysts, and customers can trust.

You'll own core parts of our data platform, which runs on dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. You'll design pipelines and data models that hold up under real operational pressure, and you'll decide what gets built now and what can wait. On a team this size, your work directly shapes how dispatch teams plan their day and how leadership makes decisions.

We work remotely four days a week. On the fifth we meet in person for planning and whiteboarding, and for the conversations that go better face to face. If you want hard problems where you can see the impact, and a real say in how the data team grows, we'd love to hear from you.
